__@unscopables@2273.description:
Is an object whose properties have the value 'true'
when they will be absent when used in a 'with' statement.

at.description: Returns the item located at the specified index.

concat.description:
Combines two or more arrays.
This method returns a new array without modifying any existing arrays.

copyWithin.description:
Returns the this object after copying a section of the array identified by start and end
to the same array starting at position target

entries.description: Returns an iterable of key, value pairs for every entry in the array

every.description: Determines whether all the members of an array satisfy the specified test.

fill.description: Changes all array elements from `start` to `end` index to a static `value` and returns the modified array

filter.description: Returns the elements of an array that meet the condition specified in a callback function.

find.description:
Returns the value of the first element in the array where predicate is true, and undefined
otherwise.

findIndex.description:
Returns the index of the first element in the array where predicate is true, and -1
otherwise.

findLast.description:
Returns the value of the last element in the array where predicate is true, and undefined
otherwise.

findLastIndex.description:
Returns the index of the last element in the array where predicate is true, and -1
otherwise.

flat.description:
Returns a new array with all sub-array elements concatenated into it recursively up to the
specified depth.

flatMap.description:
Calls a defined callback function on each element of an array. Then, flattens the result into
a new array.
This is identical to a map followed by flat with depth 1.

forEach.description: Performs the specified action for each element in an array.

includes.description: Determines whether an array includes a certain element, returning true or false as appropriate.

indexOf.description: Returns the index of the first occurrence of a value in an array, or -1 if it is not present.

join.description: Adds all the elements of an array into a string, separated by the specified separator string.

keys.description: Returns an iterable of keys in the array

lastIndexOf.description: Returns the index of the last occurrence of a specified value in an array, or -1 if it is not present.

length.description: Gets or sets the length of the array. This is a number one higher than the highest index in the array.

map.description: Calls a defined callback function on each element of an array, and returns an array that contains the results.

pop.description:
Removes the last element from an array and returns it.
If the array is empty, undefined is returned and the array is not modified.

push.description: Appends new elements to the end of an array, and returns the new length of the array.

reduce.description: Calls the specified callback function for all the elements in an array. The return value of the callback function is the accumulated result, and is provided as an argument in the next call to the callback function.

reduceRight.description: Calls the specified callback function for all the elements in an array, in descending order. The return value of the callback function is the accumulated result, and is provided as an argument in the next call to the callback function.

reverse.description:
Reverses the elements in an array in place.
This method mutates the array and returns a reference to the same array.

shift.description:
Removes the first element from an array and returns it.
If the array is empty, undefined is returned and the array is not modified.

slice.description:
Returns a copy of a section of an array.
For both start and end, a negative index can be used to indicate an offset from the end of the array.
For example, -2 refers to the second to last element of the array.

some.description: Determines whether the specified callback function returns true for any element of an array.

sort.description:
Sorts an array in place.
This method mutates the array and returns a reference to the same array.

splice.description: Removes elements from an array and, if necessary, inserts new elements in their place, returning the deleted elements.

toLocaleString.description: Returns a string representation of an array. The elements are converted to string using their toLocaleString methods.

toReversed.description: Returns a copy of an array with its elements reversed.

toSorted.description: Returns a copy of an array with its elements sorted.

toSpliced.description:
Copies an array and removes elements and, if necessary, inserts new elements in their place. Returns the copied array.
Copies an array and removes elements while returning the remaining elements.

toString.description: Returns a string representation of an array.

unshift.description: Inserts new elements at the start of an array, and returns the new length of the array.

values.description: Returns an iterable of values in the array

with.description:
Copies an array, then overwrites the value at the provided index with the
given value. If the index is negative, then it replaces from the end
of the array.

join.description: Adds all the elements of an array into a string, separated by the specified separator string.

keys.description: Returns an iterable of keys in the array

lastIndexOf.description: Returns the index of the last occurrence of a specified value in an array, or -1 if it is not present.

map.description: Calls a defined callback function on each element of an array, and returns an array that contains the results.

reverse.description:

some.description: Determines whether the specified callback function returns true for any element of an array.

sort.description:

splice.description: Removes elements from an array and, if necessary, inserts new elements in their place, returning the deleted elements.

toLocaleString.description: Returns a string representation of an array. The elements are converted to string using their toLocaleString methods.

toReversed.description: Returns a copy of an array with its elements reversed.

toSorted.description: Returns a copy of an array with its elements sorted.

toSpliced.description:

toString.description: Returns a string representation of an array.

unshift.description: Inserts new elements at the start of an array, and returns the new length of the array.

values.description: Returns an iterable of values in the array

with.description:
